name: زوج تازه‌کار بعد از اولین دعوای جدی
description: A Persian person in a new relationship had a first real fight with their partner, asks what makes a relationship actually healthy, and admits wanting to talk but being scared. Verifies the relationship thread opens, the healthy-relationship question is answered, and the fear of talking stays on the anxiety thread.

turns.text: دیروز من و همسرم اولین دعوای جدی‌مون رو داشتیم
چه چیزی یه رابطه رو واقعاً سالم می‌کنه؟
می‌خوام باهاش حرف بزنم ولی می‌ترسم

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1 opens the relationship thread (first real fight). Turn 2 answers the healthy-relationship question with substance in Persian. Turn 3 keeps the scared-to-talk disclosure on the anxiety thread.
expected.behavior: A first fight in a new relationship is normalized and given practical repair guidance, and the fear of the difficult conversation is acknowledged rather than brushed aside.
